description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sprouting Thrinax, adding {B}.
Sprouting Thrinax dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Sprouting Thrinax on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saproling tokens, adding {R}{G}.
Cast Sprouting Thrinax from the top of your library by paying {B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
